question: In 1857, who was the first to experimentally demonstrate that the yeast responsible for making alcohol from sugar, and contaminating microorganisms found in normal air, could sour fermentation?
solution:
Correct answer is** **__**Louis Pasteur**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Louis Pasteur**

 
 
• **In the 1850s and 1860s,** the French chemist and microbiologist **Louis Pasteur** became the first scientist to study fermentation, when he demonstrated that this process was **performed by living cells.**
 
• Pasteur is also known as one of the **fathers of germ theory of diseases**, which was a minor medical concept at the time.
 
• His works are ascribe to saving millions of lives through the developments of** vaccines for ****rabies and anthrax. **
 
• Pasteur was in charge for disproving the **doctrine of ****spontaneous generation.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749ad5af688601f6a4120f8d64c5d9df684d39d7e1873aa7e95ba6b7f3be27e8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Alexander Fleming

 
 
• Alexander Fleming was a Scottish physician-scientist who was recognised for **discovering penicillin**.​ 
 
 
 
• **Angelina Fanny **
 
 
• Angelina Fanny Hesse was **the first to propose the use of agar as a culture media for growing and isolating bacteria**.
 
 
 
• **Martinus Willem Beijerinck **
 
 
• Martinus Willem Beijerinck was **the first to recognize that viruses are reproducing entities that are different from other organisms**.
